ImageDescription.value:
The Gladstone Pottery Museum The Gladstone Pottery Museum is a grade II* listed site in Stoke-on-Trent, with many protected features including the bottle kilns.

This is a photo of listed building number 1195854.

There is a gallery devoted to the history of the tile, and its manufacture. There were processes such as

  • Copper plate engraving
  • Photo printed tiles

The Mintons factory pioneered

  • Samuel Wrights Encaustic tiles
  • Dust pressed tiles
  • Block printing for tile decoration
  • 'Majolica glazes'
